Evidence: U.S. funding halt, PMO spin, alliance shift
#Geopolitics #Israel #USpol

Confusing a financial severance (Q3 Physical) with a voluntary diplomatic realignment (Q4 Lyrical) to protect political optics.

Netanyahu runs a classic Smart Selfish maneuver: taking an imposed external constraint, stripping its jarring reality, and projecting it as a proactive strategic choice to preserve authority.

The Unavoidable Truth: External military subsidies can end abruptly without prior diplomatic coordination.

Actual Article Body:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu characterized the end of U.S. military aid to the Jewish state as a mutual agreement between allies, as officials wait to see who stands to benefit from the new era of “partnership and mutual investment.”

Netanyahu’s office reacted Friday to President Donald Trump’s cut to U.S. military aid, a dramatic policy change that caught government leaders in the United States and Israel off-guard. The prime minister’s team affirmed Trump’s assessment that financial support was no longer necessary because “today, Israel has a strong and stable economy.”
